description: Transient periods of strong co-activation within richly connected networks explained much of the variance and modularity of network structure, consistent with alternating integration and segregation (Esfahlani et al. 2020, as reported by Safron).
limitations: Reported secondhand in Safron 2020. The original study is not read here.

sources.quote: transient periods of strong co-activation within these networks explains much of the overall variance and modularity with respect to network structures
